How to read this table
  • Total registered painters = Active painters + Blocked painters.
  • Premium, Classic only and In progress are the active painters. A painter is in one row only, so these three add up to Active.
  • Points first / Litres first shows which target the painter reached first. It is shown only for painters who reached Classic or Premium. The % is out of that row.
  • Blocked painters are not part of qualification, so their points and litres show “—”.

Eligible Points Contribution

Where eligible qualification points come from
iWhat it showsThe sources of eligible points.How it is countedTotal = scan base + scheme bonus + approved PCC Coupon / SKU corrections. % = source ÷ total.Not countedPCC Ad Hoc, joining bonus and club bonuses.

Eligible Litres Contribution

Where eligible litres come from
iWhat it showsThe sources of eligible litres.How it is countedTotal = scan litres + litres from approved PCC Coupon / SKU entries with a pack-size mapping. % = source ÷ total.NotePCC Ad Hoc gives no litres. A missing mapping gives no litres and is flagged. Shares below 0.01% show as <0.01%.
